panels.title: Workers
panels.description: Gateway health checks, every 5 s.

panels.title: Prompt cache hit (1h)
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens reused from the KV / host-RAM cache instead of re-processed.

panels.title: Output tok/s by worker
panels.description: Generated tokens per second, all traffic to each llama-server.

panels.title: Prompt tok/s: processed vs from cache
panels.description: Processed tokens cost prefill time; cached ones are nearly free.

panels.title: Busy slots and queue
panels.description: Queued > 0 means agents are waiting for a slot: add slots, a worker, or route elsewhere.

panels.title: Decode tok/s per stream
panels.description: Speed of one stream while generating. Falls as more slots are busy.

panels.title: Prefill tok/s per stream
panels.description: Prompt processing speed on uncached tokens; drives time to first token.

panels.title: Gateway routing decisions
panels.description: retry and fallback should stay near zero.

panels.title: Tool latency (mean)
panels.description: search_docs includes embedding the query and reranking the candidates on the CPU.

panels.title: Tool errors (24h)
panels.description: fetch_url errors include refused private addresses and dead links.

panels.title: Embedding and rerank tokens/s
panels.description: CPU work done for indexing and searching.

panels.title: Lab power now
panels.description: Desktop + server box + Jetson. GPU/CPU/board power is measured where the hardware reports it; the rest of each box is an estimate (overheads and PSU efficiency in .env).

panels.title: Cost, last 24 h
panels.description: At your all-in retail rate. Under retail net metering every kWh the lab uses is worth the retail rate even while the panels produce (it would otherwise be exported for retail credit); only surplus left at the annual true-up is credited lower. Reads $0 until ELECTRIC_RATE_SUMMER/WINTER are set in .env.

panels.title: Projected per month
panels.description: Last 24 h average cost per hour x 730 hours.

panels.title: Rate now
panels.description: $/kWh in effect: the summer rate June-September, otherwise the winter rate.

panels.title: Lab energy from your solar (24 h)
panels.description: The lab's share of the house's use times the share of the house covered by solar at that minute. Needs the gateway's consumption CTs.

panels.title: Solar, house and grid
panels.description: From the Enphase IQ Gateway on the LAN. House and grid need consumption CTs; without them only solar shows.

panels.title: Solar gateway
panels.description: Down: no token in secrets/envoy.token, an expired token (owner tokens last a year), or the gateway is unreachable.

panels.title: GPU junction (max, 24h)
panels.description: Hotspot temperature. Warning at 95 °C, critical at 103 °C; the card throttles at 110 °C.

panels.title: Minutes above 95 °C (24h)
panels.description: Time the GPU hotspot spent above the warning line today.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Firing and pending alerts; they also push to ntfy.

panels.title: GPU temperatures

targets.expr: (node_hwmon_temp_celsius * on (chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{label=~"edge|junction|mem"}) and on (chip) node_hwmon_sensor_label{label="junction"}

panels.description: junction = hottest point on the die; mem = GDDR6 (rated to 105 °C).

panels.title: GPU power and fan
panels.description: The card holds itself under its power cap; fan duty rises with temperature.

panels.title: 6900 XT hotspot (max, 24h)
panels.description: Warning at 95 °C, critical at 103 °C; RDNA2 throttles at 110 °C.

panels.title: Desktop sensors
panels.description: Down when the desktop is off, asleep, or LibreHardwareMonitor isn't running.

panels.title: 6900 XT power, fan, VRAM
panels.description: Fan duty 0 at idle is the card's zero-RPM mode.

panels.title: 5950X and board temperatures
panels.description: Ryzen 5000 limit is 90 °C.

panels.title: Jetson junction (max, 24h)
panels.description: Orin junction temperature. Warning at 85 °C, critical at 95 °C; it throttles near 99 °C.

panels.title: Jetson sensors
panels.description: node_exporter on the Jetson; temperatures come from a textfile script (jetson-sensors.service).

panels.title: Jetson power
panels.description: From the INA3221 rail monitor. MAXN SUPER mode allows up to 25 W.

panels.title: Jetson memory (shared CPU+GPU)
panels.description: Embedder + reranker use about 2 GB; the 8 GB is shared with the GPU.

panels.title: VRAM used
panels.description: The worker holds model + KV for all slots; under 10 GB at 4x32k.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: The CPU model's work shows up here.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Includes the GPU worker's host-RAM prompt cache.
